privacy.intro: Blakkis 🐐 ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use the Blakkis mobile application ("the App").
privacy.purposeDescription: Blakkis is specifically designed as a social drink tracking application, not a Blood Alcohol Content (BAC) calculator. Our app:

purposeList.noBac: Does NOT calculate Blood Alcohol Content: Blakkis does not attempt to measure or calculate your actual blood alcohol concentration.
purposeList.noMedical: Does NOT provide medical measurements: The visualizations and data presented in the app are not clinical measurements and should not be treated as such.
purposeList.noDriving: Does NOT indicate fitness to drive: Never use Blakkis to determine whether you are fit to drive, operate machinery, or engage in any activity that requires sobriety.
purposeList.noAdvice: Does NOT replace professional medical advice: The app cannot and does not attempt to predict your actual level of impairment.

privacy.purposeNote1: Blakkis is intended solely for personal tracking and social sharing of drink consumption patterns. The impact visualizations in the app are rough approximations based on self-reported data and general population models, which cannot account for individual physiological differences that affect how alcohol is processed by your body.
privacy.purposeNote2: For accurate information about alcohol's effects, please consult medical professionals. Never make health or safety decisions based on information provided by this app.
privacy.section1aDescription: When you use the app, you may provide limited personal data used for visualizing your drink consumption patterns and enabling group functionality:
privacy.section1aNote: This data is stored securely on our cloud-hosted backend.
privacy.section1bNote: These are also stored in the cloud to enable syncing across devices and group sharing features.
privacy.section2Description: We use your data only to:

section2List.visualizations: Display visualizations of your drink consumption patterns
section2List.history: Show your drinking history and consumption trends
section2List.groups: Enable group sharing and comparisons (if opted in)
section2List.profile: Maintain your user profile for use across sessions or devices

privacy.section2Note: We do not use your data for advertising, third-party analytics, or any other commercial purposes.
privacy.section3Description: All user data is securely stored on our cloud backend with appropriate technical and organizational safeguards to protect against unauthorized access.
privacy.section3Note: While we don't collect real names, email addresses, or phone numbers, we still treat your nickname and related data with care, using encryption and secure connections (e.g., HTTPS) at all times.
privacy.section4Description: We do not sell, rent, or share your data with third parties.
privacy.section4GroupDescription: If you choose to join or create a group, only the following information is shared and visible to other group members:
privacy.section4PrivateNote: Your gender, weight, height, birth year, or any other personal attributes are never visible to others. This sensitive information is used only for internal visualization calculations and is stored securely.
privacy.section4LeaveNote: You may leave a group at any time to stop sharing data with other members.
privacy.section5Description: Blakkis includes optional group functionality, allowing users to compare their drinking logs and consumption visualizations with friends or others.
privacy.section5VisibilityDescription: Within a group, members will only see:
privacy.section5PrivacyNote: We intentionally limit visibility to protect your privacy. Personal characteristics such as weight, height, gender, and birth year are never shown to other users.
privacy.section5ReportNote: We encourage respectful participation in groups. If inappropriate behavior occurs, please report it by contacting us at info@blakkis.com.

section6List.delete: Delete your account and all associated data upon request
section6List.contact: Contact us with questions or concerns

privacy.section6DeleteNote: You can request data deletion by emailing us at info@blakkis.com.
privacy.section7Description: Blakkis is intended for users 17 years and older. We do not knowingly collect information from individuals under 17. If we learn that someone under 17 has provided data, we will delete it immediately.
privacy.section8Description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we'll revise the "Last updated" date above. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
privacy.section9Description: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
